_comment: Registry of every distinct strategy configuration evaluated against this
dataset over the life of the project. It exists because multiple-testing
corrections require a trial count, and a trial count supplied after the
fact is worthless. Each entry was added when the configuration was run,
not when the results were written up.
Trials 1-26 were run before the 2026-09-24 freeze and are the count used
in the haircut and Deflated Sharpe calculations. Trials 27 onward are
REGISTERED BUT NOT RUN: they were written down, with a predicted
direction, before touching the data. Registering a trial has a cost,
because the count feeds the corrections -- which is the point of keeping
a register rather than a memory.
Honesty note: this registry covers configurations run by THIS project.
It cannot cover the configurations the rest of the world has run on
Chinese A-share data since 1991, which is why the Harvey-Liu haircut is

Trial 30 was prompted by a reader's objection rather than by the author, and is recorded that way: the lot constraint was visible in the data all along and had been treated as an implementation detail rather than as a co-equal bound.
also reported against a literature-scale test count.

trials.motivation: docs/05 section 5.1: quality has Rank IC 0.0055, Newey-West t = 0.49, hit rate 49.2%, and marginal IC turning negative by quarter four. It carries 25% of the composite weight.
trials.prediction: Composite Rank IC rises from 0.0687 toward the 0.07-0.08 range and its t rises above 5.59; portfolio Sharpe improves by less than the IC does, because costs and constraints are unchanged.
trials.why_not_run: The quality result was measured on the same sample that would justify removing it. Running this now and reporting the improved composite would be fitting the data twice and presenting the second fit as a discovery. To be evaluated on the frozen holdout.

trials.what: annual rather than quarterly rebalancing
trials.motivation: docs/05 section 5.2: marginal Rank IC at quarter six is still 54% of quarter one for low volatility and 60% for the composite. A_min is linear in rebalance frequency f.
trials.prediction: A_min falls below CNY 2,000 (from CNY 3,643) for any measured annual turnover tau1 <= 1.0; net CAGR at small account sizes improves; gross alpha falls somewhat because the signal is sampled less often.
trials.how_to_test: Set 调仓频率 to "年" in config.json and re-run research/capacity.py, which measures tau1 rather than assuming it.

trials.what: low volatility as an exclusion rule (drop the most volatile decile) rather than a ranking
trials.motivation: docs/05 section 5.4: the decile-1-to-decile-2 step is 1.45pp of the 3.18pp total spread -- 46% of the effect in one of nine steps. An exclusion turns over far less often than a ranking.
trials.prediction: Captures roughly half the decile spread at materially lower turnover, so net alpha at small account sizes improves even though gross alpha falls.

trials.what: solve the lot constraint and the fee floor jointly, rather than reporting the fee floor alone
trials.motivation: docs/02 section 2.4b: A-shares trade in lots of 100 shares, so capital per position has a second, mechanical floor of 100 x price. Measured lot costs for the names this strategy holds run CNY 250 to 2,500 against a fee requirement of CNY 304, so the lot constraint binds at five of six tested account sizes. The published A_min reports only the fee side.
trials.prediction: The jointly-solved minimum is materially higher than CNY 3,643 -- around CNY 15,000 for a 12-position book -- and the fee floor becomes the binding constraint only where the strategy selects unusually cheap names.
trials.how_to_test: research/capacity.py now measures median_lot_cost_cny from the names actually held and reports binding_minimum(); re-running it produces the joint answer. The closed form and its tests are already in cost_model.py.

n_trials_note: Only trials with status 'run' count toward the multiple-testing corrections. Registered-but-unrun trials are listed so that the count is honest when they are run.
literature_scale_source: Harvey, Liu & Zhu (RFS 2016) count 316 published factors as of 2012; they argue the true number of tests is far larger because of publication bias.

oos_freeze.rule: The configuration recorded in config.json at this commit is frozen. Any future change to universe filters, gates, factor weights or rebalance frequency must be added to this registry BEFORE the backtest is run, with a predicted direction, and the frozen configuration's record continues to be reported alongside.
oos_freeze.holdout_note: The last 3 years were held out of all configuration decisions in trials 1-26; those trials were evaluated on 2011-01..2023-09 only.
